name: Workyard Waterworks U4 Pulley Station v1 — Concept Fidelity
subtitle: Bucket-pulley station: pegged frame, drum, crank, rope guide, hook, lesson bucket
review_note: The station keeps the pegged posts with angled back braces and iron foot brackets, top crossbeam, jib arm with a guide wheel in iron cheek plates, winch drum with flanges and visible rope wraps on an iron axle, offset crank arm with a worn wooden grip at working height, taut fall rope to an iron hook engaging the bucket's arched bail, an individually staved bucket with two iron hoops and a genuinely recessed open interior, and the cantilevered set-down ledge. Deviations: the concept's spiral rope coil is richer than our three clean wraps, and the ledge sits beside the drop line rather than under it — a deliberate correction so the animated bucket can never clip it.
improve: None blocking; do not scale the frame above 2.17 tiles or the crank grip leaves comfortable working height.
